C2-R9.answer:
The strongest facts we have are direct observations of 67 bird species and 14 snake species (with 3 seen in a three-day 2024 survey) at Elephants by the Lake. We also have indirect evidence of two elephant passage events supported by physical signs, and reported data on a 110-species nursery with 15,000 saplings from July 2024. There is also a reported record of roughly one acre of Eucalyptus removal.

Important gaps include the lack of local confirmation for Lantana presence, and the elephant evidence is indirect rather than direct sightings. We do not have direct observations of elephants, only indirect signs of passage. For a new field colleague, priority would be to measure elephant presence directly and confirm the presence or absence of Lantana in the area.
